'''T. Orini''' was a member of the [[Liana Liberators]]. The name ''T. Orini'' name was an alias used as part of the Liberator's attempt to pose as members of the [[Alderaanian Biological Research Institute]] when they came to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It is unknown what the real name of this person was.
